chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Baghdadi al-Varraq narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad, the servant of al-Rashid, quoted Darim ibn Qabaysa who quoted Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) who narrated from his father Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Hussein, from his father al-Hussein ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The Resurrection will occur on Friday between the noon and afternoon prayers.
ai.seo_question: When will the Day of Resurrection occur according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration, transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt chain in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, highlights the eschatological significance of Friday as the day of resurrection, a view supported by Shia scholars who link it to the creation of Adam and the final judgment. The specific timing between Dhuhr and Asr underscores the sanctity of the midday hours, inviting believers to reflect on the transient nature of worldly life during these blessed times.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-85 Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Baghdady al-Var’raq narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad - the servant of Ar-Rashid - quoted Darim ibn Qabaysat narrated that Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha (MGB) quoted on the authority of his father Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim (MGB), on the authority of his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad (MGB), on the authority of his father Muhammad ibn Ali (MGB), on the authority of his father Ali ibn al-Hussein (MGB), on the authority of his father Al-Hussein ibn Ali (MGB), on the authority of his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB), that the Prophet (MGB) said, “
The Resurrection Day shall come between the times of the noon and afternoon prayers on a Friday.”
